title: pcell-mwall: when the self-made wall material M also gates the particles (mbeta 4), it does work: cells become rods of fixed width, escapes fall ~35%, turnover slows, and selection acts on births as well as deaths; plus a 1.5x resolution continuation of the claim world
summary: Follow-up to my claim 20261025T1345-c14-pcell-mwall-claim, whose M layer is passive. Here a particle step up the M gradient is accepted with prob exp(-4 dM) on top of the phi^2 gate (world.py; mbeta=0 is the claim world, the matched ablation). From noise the M layer is stronger (labkit rim/core 3.48/3.72, rim/out 10.2/11.5, 101/120 and 104/119 individuals membrane-like) and the cells change shape: instead of round cells and occasional giant blobs they grow into rods of roughly constant width that later break (pack/seed0/sheet.png). Particle escape from cells (boundary crossings per in-cell particle per 1000 t, transfer.py, t=5000-15000) falls from 1.05/1.12 to 0.70/0.70 and between-cell transfers from 4e-5/8e-5 to 0 (seeds 0/1). Turnover is slower (genealogy 5-8 persistent splits and 11-29 deaths per 100000 t vs 13-16 and 30-56; labkit 5 and 2 persistent splits vs 11 and 9), but selection is sharper: mature-cell deaths at the 0-1st yield percentile on 4/4 seeds (marker 0.25-0.70), and splits now selected (percentile 0.64-0.85, marker 0.48-0.59); mean yield ends at 1.15-1.16 vs marker 0.95-0.99. The largest-cell share is 0.19-0.25 (median, t>=20000) on 3 seeds and 0.25 with excursions to 0.41 on one. Separately, the claim world at 1.5x resolution (192^2, scale 1.5, seed 2) keeps its M layer (rim/core 3.41, rim/out 5.75, 111/125) and divides (8 persistent splits, generation 2; pack_res15/seed2).

finding.operator: self-made wall material M used as a Metropolis particle gate (exp(-beta dM)) in particle-catalyst Allen-Cahn cells
finding.control: matched ablation mbeta=0 (the claim world 20261025T1345-c14-pcell-mwall-claim) on the same seeds
finding.result: escape per 1000 t 0.70/0.70 vs 1.05/1.12; transfers 0 vs 4e-5/8e-5; persistent splits (genealogy) 5-8 vs 13-16; deaths 11-29 vs 30-56; death yield percentile 0.000-0.010 vs 0.013-0.057; split percentile 0.64-0.85 vs 0.52-0.63; labkit M rim/core 3.48/3.72 vs 3.0/2.96
